dedupe_keys.name: nepal district level maize and wheat yield and climate panel 1981 2023

description: A district-year panel of crop yields and climate for Nepal. The Zenodo record says the dataset covers 77 districts over 43 years (1981 to 2023), with 3,311 district-year observations per crop and 30 variables: maize and wheat yields in kg/ha from MoALD SINA reports; rainfall, temperature, dry days and extreme precipitation from DHM Nepal and ERA5-Land; seasonal anomalies and SPI-3 for the kharif and rabi seasons; MODIS NDVI for 2001 to 2023; and features such as lagged yields, monsoon onset lag and disaster and yield shock flags. It supported a machine learning early warning system for yields. A CSV with a codebook is free to download under CC BY 4.0, version 1.0.0 of 18 June 2026. Coverage is Nepal. Caveats: official district yields may be revised, and the paper was only submitted. For simulation it links droughts and monsoon anomalies to district yield shocks. A related catalogue record is the Nepal staple crop map.
